subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be scoped to documenting the existing pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw add a supported TUI keybinding preference for Enter/Ctrl/Cmd/Shift+Enter behavior?
rationale: Current runtime already has dependency-backed Shift+Enter support, while the remaining configurable-keybinding request would add public config/CLI behavior under a repo policy that keeps new config surfaces high-bar.

options.title: Docs/help first
options.body: Document Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J/backslash-enter behavior and terminal limitations now, and track configurable send shortcuts only after a maintainer approves the config surface.

options.title: Add TUI keybinding config
options.body: Expose a supported TUI keybinding preference wired into pi-tui and cover default and customized send/newline behavior in tests and docs.

options.title: Close as runtime-covered
options.body: Treat dependency-backed Shift+Enter as sufficient and decline the docs/config remainder, preserving related WebChat/external-editor issues separately.

recommendation.title: Docs/help first
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J/backslash-enter behavior and terminal limitations now, and track configurable send shortcuts only after a maintainer approves the config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the strongest current TUI code/docs history signal and already left the prior scope-setting review comment on this issue.
